A note on the room

Materials & image credits

The paintings are Randall Farmer’s original work. Their color, composition, and painted details are shown from the approved digital masters. The frames and gallery lighting are built in CSS; no AI-generated versions of the paintings are used.

Photographic textures

  • Old wooden dark board by AS Photography / WDnet Studio, via Wikimedia Commons, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Used as a cropped, darkened page texture with CSS overlays.
  • Burgundy rough-cast plaster wall texture by Sisters.seamless, via Wikimedia Commons, dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
  • Stone Wall Texture by ISO Legacy, via Wikimedia Commons, dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.

The three optimized texture files are bundled with this gallery, so the page does not need to fetch its backgrounds from a third-party host.
